name: Anchor
description: Anchor points on a ring, with the centre of the cell held down as well.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @m6(radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 96%, #0000 96%) @plot(r: 0.6; move: 0.5 0.5) / 24% 24% no-repeat); mask: @m6(radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 96%, #0000 96%) @plot(r: 0.6; move: 0.5 0.5) / 24% 24% no-repeat); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 40%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
